decision.detail: I set the coffee mug down on the lobby table, still warm, and pick up the camera bag. I walk out of the Hearthside to the Rialto. I don't announce it to the crew. I just go. The camera is in my hand, the one red light on top still warm from last night's charge. I find Alma in the projection booth, the big reel sitting on the shelf beside her. I hold the camera up, steady, both hands. I press record. I don't say 'action.' I just hold the frame on her face and let her talk. The light through the booth window is flat, grey, February. Her hands are on the reel. She talks to her daughter. I hold the shot for as long as she needs. I stop the record. I walk back to the hotel.
decision.intention: The Rialto is closing. This is the one window where she says it to someone who isn't in the room. The party is a rehearsal. The lights will be there again tomorrow. Alma at the booth, talking to Pittsburgh, is not coming back. The daughter already asked to hear it once. I'm not going to be the reason it's gone.
decision.words: I say to whoever's still at the table: 'I'm taking the Rialto. You guys cover the ballroom tonight.' I don't wait for an answer. I'm already at the door with the bag over my shoulder.
